clue.text: Protective cover Queen got from prime minister

indicators.note: the Queen is got from, i.e. extracted out of, the prime minister's name

parts.note: Margaret Thatcher, UK prime minister 1979-90
ER, Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: A monarch is handed a shield or umbrella by the prime minister.
explanation.walkthrough: 'got from' signals taking ER (Queen) out of THATCHER.
explanation.definitionFit: A thatched roof of straw or reed is a covering that keeps weather out of a building.

clue.text: Where travellers pay to go and fish

parts.note: a turn is a go, a chance to play
the pike is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: Travellers pay to go fishing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pay to go' reads as one phrase; the definition stops at 'pay'.
explanation.definitionFit: A turnpike is a toll road or toll gate, where drivers must pay a fee.

clue.text: Refuse a black mark

parts.note: B is the pencil abbreviation for black
a stain is a mark

explanation.surface: Turning down a black mark against one's name.
explanation.definitionFit: To abstain is to decline to do something, especially to vote.

clue.text: Skill I learnt initially in prison which some find hard to swallow

definitions.text: which some find hard to swallow

indicators.note: in places the skill and following pieces inside the prison

parts.note: a cage is a prison
art is skill

indicators.note: initially says to take the opening letter of the word learnt

explanation.surface: A skill learnt in jail that some find hard to believe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hard to swallow' suggests something unbelievable; here it is literally chewy gristle.
explanation.definitionFit: Cartilage is tough gristle found in meat, which many diners struggle to chew and swallow.

clue.text: Share mistake and initially even Wall Street stalls?

parts.note: a part is a share of something
to err is to make a mistake

indicators.note: initially says to take only the opening letter of the word even

explanation.surface: Trading talk: share blunders send even the New York market into a stall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wall Street' stands for American usage: in a US theatre the parterre is the seating on the main floor, the British stalls. The question mark flags the stretch.
explanation.definitionFit: In American theatres the parterre is the ground-floor seating area, what Britons call the stalls.

clue.text: Convincing oneself car has motion

parts.note: auto is a car
a motion is a proposal put forward, a suggestion

explanation.surface: Persuading yourself that your car moves.
explanation.definitionFit: Autosuggestion is self-hypnosis, persuading one's own mind through repeated ideas.

clue.text: Dynamic person is good in bank

indicators.note: in places the good inside the bank

parts.note: a tier is a bank, a row as of seats

explanation.surface: An energetic worker is good at the bank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bank' suggests money; it is a tier, a row.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone energetic and fierce is called a tiger, a forceful go-getter.

clue.text: Soft cases used by opera violinists

indicators.note: used by says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Instrument cases of soft material carried by opera players.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cases' suggests violin cases; they are pasta parcels.
explanation.definitionFit: Ravioli are small pasta envelopes holding a filling, soft cases of dough.

clue.text: Chap from Eagle Street

parts.note: the erne is a sea eagle

explanation.surface: A man from a road named after an eagle.
explanation.definitionFit: Ernest is a man's first name, and crosswords treat any such name as a chap.

clue.text: Soft-hearted person posted current crew thanks and tip

parts.note: sent means posted, as a letter
I is the physics symbol for electric current
men are a crew
ta is British informal for thanks
to list is to tip or lean over, as a ship

explanation.surface: A kindly soul mails a power bill, thanks to the workforce, with a gratuity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tip' suggests a gratuity; it is a lean. TA is British slang for thanks.
explanation.definitionFit: A sentimentalist is moved by tender feelings, easily stirred to emotion.

clue.text: Concerned with small emergency arising once more

parts.note: re means concerning or about
S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small
as an adjective, emergency means urgent, as in emergency measures

explanation.surface: A report on a minor crisis flaring up again.
explanation.definitionFit: Something resurgent is rising again after a decline, coming back into strength.

clue.text: Vouchsafed information about Roman square

indicators.note: about means placed around, so the information wraps the other piece

parts.note: gen is British slang for information
IV is four in Roman numerals, and four is a square number

explanation.surface: Someone was granted details of a piazza in Rome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'square' looks like a town square; it means a square number, four, written IV.
explanation.definitionFit: To vouchsafe something is to grant or bestow it, so what was vouchsafed was given.

clue.text: Perfectionist maybe disposing of uranium to key operator

indicators.note: disposing of means getting rid of, so these letters are removed

parts.note: a utopianist, believer in a perfect society, is one kind of perfectionist
U is the chemical symbol for uranium

explanation.surface: A fussy idealist drops a radioactive element to become a crucial worker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'key operator' reads as an important employee; it is someone who operates keys on a piano.
explanation.definitionFit: A pianist plays by pressing the keys of the keyboard, so operates keys.

clue.text: Concerned with component of blood containing iodine — that's worrying

indicators.note: containing means holding inside, so the iodine sits within the other word

parts.note: serous means relating to serum, a component of blood
I is the chemical symbol for iodine

explanation.surface: A medical worry about blood containing iodine.
explanation.definitionFit: A serious situation is grave and gives cause for concern.

clue.text: Country parrot seen round city

indicators.note: seen round means placed around, so the parrot encloses the city

parts.note: the kea is a New Zealand parrot
NY is New York

explanation.surface: A parrot spotted flying around a city in some nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Kenya is an East African nation.

clue.text: Trap surrounded by enchantment is irresistible

indicators.note: surrounded by means the trap is placed inside the enchantment

parts.note: magic is enchantment
a net is a trap

explanation.surface: A snare wrapped in a spell cannot be resisted.
explanation.definitionFit: A magnetic personality attracts powerfully, hard to resist.

clue.text: Company went without leader as old as you and I

indicators.note: without leader means the first letter of went is dropped

parts.note: as old as you and I are means of our age

explanation.surface: A firm, leaderless, goes on as old as us.
explanation.definitionFit: An entourage is a retinue or group accompanying an important person, a company of attendants.

clue.text: Royal Opera House deployed piano only, a real sleep inducer

parts.note: ROH is the abbreviation for London's Royal Opera House

indicators.note: deployed means arranged or set out, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: P is the music abbreviation for piano, softly

explanation.surface: A performance at Covent Garden using only piano sends audiences to sleep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deployed' is the anagram signal; the surface makes it sound like staging a recital. 'real' insists it is a genuine sedative, not dull music.
explanation.definitionFit: Rohypnol is a powerful sedative drug prescribed to induce sleep.

clue.text: One imprisoned in lead alloy by English

parts.note: terne is an alloy of lead and tin

explanation.surface: A metallurgy note: some English lead alloy.
explanation.definitionFit: An internee is a person confined, as in wartime detention, without trial.

clue.text: Tending to race up and burst into song

indicators.note: up, in a down clue, says the race is read from bottom to top

parts.note: to run is to race
to sing is to burst into song

explanation.surface: Inclined to dash up and start singing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tending to' reads as 'inclined to'; it means caring for.
explanation.definitionFit: Nursing a patient means looking after them, caring for their needs.

clue.text: Volunteers express disapproval — that's not acceptable

parts.note: the TA, Territorial Army, is Britain's volunteer reserve force
to boo is to jeer in disapproval

explanation.surface: Reservists jeer at something improper.
explanation.walkthrough: The TA (Territorial Army) is the British Army's part-time volunteer reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: A taboo practice is socially forbidden, beyond what custom permits.

clue.text: West African country introducing unknown energy fuel mixture

indicators.note: introducing means the country takes in the unknown letter

parts.note: Benin is a West African nation
Z is an algebraic unknown
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A West African state brings in an unknown blend of fuel.
explanation.definitionFit: Benzine is a hydrocarbon mix from petroleum, used as a fuel and solvent.

clue.text: Rule first cells must be set up for admission

indicators.note: set up, in a down clue, says the letters read from bottom to top
first says the rule comes ahead of the cells

parts.note: a law is a rule
ova are egg cells

explanation.surface: A regulation on prison cells being built before letting anyone in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cells' suggests jail; they are egg cells. 'admission' is a confession, not entry.
explanation.definitionFit: An avowal is an open declaration or confession, an admission of something.

clue.text: Garden flower that's female outside, male inside

indicators.note: outside says the female name goes around the other piece
inside says the male name goes within the other piece

parts.note: Vera is a woman's name
Ben is a man's name

explanation.surface: A plant whose blooms are female on the outside and male within.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests flower biology, stamens and pistils; the sexes are a girl's name and a boy's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Verbena is a flowering plant often grown in gardens and borders.

clue.text: Record single up around number four in chart

indicators.note: around means the reversed single wraps the letter from the chart
up, in a down clue, says the single is read from bottom to top

parts.note: single means lone, by itself

indicators.note: number four in asks for the fourth letter of chart

explanation.surface: A single climbs to number four in the charts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'single' and 'chart' suggest pop music; 'single' means lone, and 'chart' is only a word to pick a letter from.
explanation.definitionFit: To enrol someone is to enter their name on a register, to record them.

clue.text: Little time before long trip, missing start for early contest

indicators.note: before puts the time ahead of the next piece

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for time

indicators.note: missing start means the first letter of the trip is dropped

parts.note: a journey is a long trip

explanation.surface: A short pause before a lengthy trip, skipping the opening of an old competition.
explanation.definitionFit: A tourney was a medieval jousting tournament between knights.

clue.text: Sound beginning when hummingbird is rapidly returning

indicators.note: beginning asks for the opening letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: The noise a hummingbird makes as it darts back.
explanation.definitionFit: A whirr is a continuous buzzing or vibrating noise, such as rapidly beating wings make.

clue.text: Is old feeling of delight not starting, being alone?

indicators.note: not starting means the first letter of the word for delight is dropped

parts.note: elation is a feeling of great joy

explanation.surface: Asking whether old joy has faded in solitude.
explanation.definitionFit: Isolation is the state of being separated from others, entirely on one's own.

clue.text: Member got off by unknown feature of law

parts.note: a leg is a limb, a bodily member
alit means got down, as from a bus
Y is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: A club member acquitted by an unidentified point of law.
explanation.walkthrough: 'got off' suggests escaping a charge; it means alighted.
explanation.definitionFit: Legality, being lawful, is a quality that belongs to the law.

clue.text: European power limited by genuine revocation

indicators.note: limited by means hemmed in, so the pieces sit inside the word for genuine

parts.note: real means genuine
P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: European authority curbed by authentic cancellation.
explanation.definitionFit: To repeal a law is to revoke or annul it officially.
